import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689764/attempts/e81e54f2f2424f1b8a6d71322cea1218/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid); m=len(grid[0])
    colors=sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v})
    objs=[]
    for color in colors:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(n) for c in range(m) if grid[r][c]==color]
        r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
        objs.append((c0,r0,color,[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]))
    objs.sort()
    out=[[0]*m for _ in range(n)]
    ar=ac=0
    for i,(c0,r0,color,pts) in enumerate(objs):
        if i:
            # start at prior object's bottom-right occupied bounding-box cell
            ar=pr+ph-1; ac=pc+pw-1
        ph=max(r for r,c in pts)+1; pw=max(c for r,c in pts)+1
        pr,pc=ar,ac
        for dr,dc in pts:
            if 0<=ar+dr<n and 0<=ac+dc<m: out[ar+dr][ac+dc]=color
    return out
'''
(base/'task-7d892bce.py').write_text(code)
